info.name: JobMate
info.description:
Gateway API for JobMate. Import into Postman (IntelliJ Community has no HTTP Client).

1. Set baseUrl to http://localhost:5007 (IDE) or http://localhost:5050 (Docker Compose).
2. Run Auth signups then logins — Tests scripts store JWTs.
3. adminToken only works for an existing ROLE_ADMIN; signup cannot create admins.
4. Do not send X-User-Id; the gateway sets identity from the JWT.
